title: Academic and Industry Collaborations
description: Our students benefit from key strategic partnerships in Ticino, Switzerland, and internationally.

blocks.html:
Our students benefit from a strong network of academic and industry collaborations in Ticino, across Switzerland, and internationally. These partnerships open up valuable opportunities for:

  • Internships in tourism
  • Jobs in tourism
  • Scholarships
  • Master Thesis research support
  • Participating in international conferences and master classes on different topics such as smart tourism, cultural tourism, sustainable tourism
  • Summer Schools on ICT to develop and promote Sustainable Tourism in World Heritage Sites by our UNESCO Chair

These opportunities are made possible through our close collaboration with key partners:

Industry Partners

  • International Federation for IT in Travel & Tourism (IFITT)
  • Skål International Lugano International Association of Travel and Tourism Professionals
  • Destination Management Organisations in Ticino and Switzerland
  • Ente Regionale per lo Sviluppo del Locarnese e Vallemaggia

Academic Partners

  • UNESCO Chair in ICT to develop and promote Sustainable Tourism in World Heritage Sites (USI Lugano, Switzerland)
  • Tourism Observatory (O-Tur) of the Canton of Ticino (USI Lugano, Switzerland)
  • UNISG – University of Gastronomic Sciences

Are you interested in becoming an Academic or Tourism Industry Partner of our USI Master in International Tourism programme? Please contact us: mt@usi.ch
